Messy website? Your iPhone already has the fix. 3 Safari buttons, all in the Page Menu.

#1 Hide Distracting Items: tap a banner or popup and it disappears
#2 Show Reader: just the words and photos, nothing else
#3 Listen to Page: Safari reads the article out loud while you do something else

To open the Page Menu, tap the button at the left of the address bar. Hide Distracting Items needs iOS 18 or later. To bring hidden items back, open the Page Menu and tap Show Hidden Items.

Which website needs this the most? Tell me in the comments.

Save this for the next messy website you open.

Your Action button can do a lot more than switch on Silent mode.

#1 Visual Intelligence to ask about anything you point at
#2 Recognize Music to name a song in 1 press
#3 Translate for conversations when you travel
#4 Voice Memo to save an idea in 1 second
#5 Magnifier for tiny print and dim menus
#6 Controls to put any Control Center control on it
#7 Shortcut to run your own routine

Change it in Settings, then Action Button, and swipe to pick. Works on iPhone 15 Pro and newer. Visual Intelligence needs an iPhone with Apple Intelligence.

Your iPhone's Photos app already does what most paid editing apps charge for.
 
#1 Clean Up erases strangers from the background
#2 Extend widens a tight shot
#3 Reframe changes the angle after you took the photo
#4 Portrait photos let you change the blur and the focus later
#5 The Crop dial fixes crooked shots and perspective
#6 Copy edits from 1 photo and paste them onto the rest
#7 The Lock Screen tucks the clock behind your subject
 
Clean Up, Extend and Reframe need iOS 27 with Apple Intelligence.

iOS 27 lets you turn Liquid Glass off. Settings> Appearance> Liquid Glass. Drag left for clear, right for fully tinted. Tinted is the one that makes text readable again on a busy wallpaper. It applies system-wide, so every app follows it. Save this. #iOS27 #iPhoneTips #Apple #LiquidGlass
